purpose: obtain the originally registered V88 scientific outcome after a pre-scoring harness identity failure
onlyAuthorizedChange: copy the harness-provided fixture name field unchanged into the scored row before the harness identity check
frozenUnchangedDependencies: local model repository, revision, and snapshot

decisionRule.ifExecutionCompletes: apply every unchanged original V88 gate and freeze the result positive or negative
decisionRule.ifExecutionFailsAgain: freeze V88r1 execution-inconclusive and stop without another retry
decisionRule.ifAnyScientificGateFails: freeze negative without prompt, record, model, decoder, parser, scorer, control, or threshold changes
